faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) for filling up senior civil engineering leadership positions on deputation with immediate absorption.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post notified under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notified post is Executive Director (Civil) under the civil department of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited based in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in RVNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Executive Director (Civil) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B. Tech degree in Civil Engineering or its equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution along with relevant project experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for the Executive Director post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 57 years, reckoned as on the closing date of the vacancy notice published by RVNL.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary under the IDA E-9 pay scale ranging from Rs. 1,50,000 to Rs. 3,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by email to the designated RVNL address is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Through which mode should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to download the application proforma and send their complete application in PDF format via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for RVNL Executive Director Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility and experience, followed by an interview and a medical fitness examination.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited at www.rvnl.org to access detailed recruitment notifications and career updates.
